publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Sabino

record.title: Quiet EP0 advances beyond the address fault
record.method: Matched quiet control and bounded host/device events
record.observation: Suppressing synchronous hot-path UART prints permits verified FADDR application 1.136083 ms after the status command and an addressed 18-byte descriptor. Configuration then fails at a guard seeing stale DATAEND.
record.limits: This supports logging as a latency contributor, not the only cause. It does not measure status-IRQ-to-FADDR latency or individual wire ACKs. Later protocol gates supersede this earlier fault.
